criteria.question: with the labellar taste afferents split by modality (Tastekin et al. 2026), was the feeding negative an artefact of mixed drive, and is valence encoded in sign?
criteria.source: Tastekin, de Haan Vicente et al. 2026, Cell 189:5527-5551, Fig. 2 (modality assignments)

protocol.model: declared parameter set (LIFParams), electrical synapses on, no baseline, no regional gain

F1_verdict.rule: reported as a verdict, not scored: RETRACT the feeding negative if sugar's ratio >= 1.0 OR its signed 2-hop path product to MN9 > 0; else STRENGTHEN

F2_sugar_ratio_exceeds_bitter.rule: point record, graph arithmetic: sugar's ratio minus bitter's ratio (synapses onto MN9's excitatory relays / onto its inhibitory relays, denominator floored at 1) is above 0

F3_sugar_drives_mn9_at_100hz.rule: MN9 spikes/cell/pulse under sugar (LB3b, LB3c) at 100 Hz, bootstrap over pulses: PASS if the 95% interval lies at or above 0.5

F4_bitter_below_sugar_at_100hz.rule: MN9 under sugar minus under bitter (LB1a-d), both at 100 Hz: two separate simulations, each resampled over its own pulses: PASS if the 95% interval lies above 0

electrical: shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Tanouye & Wyman 1980; Allen et al. 2006
shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Allen et al. 2006; Phelan et al. 2008
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
intrinsic: all-or-none GF response; von Reyn 2014; Ache 2019. Fitted by pre-stated rule (smallest value giving 1-2 spikes/response, <=2 on the strongest gain quartile, P(response) 0.5-1, TTMn relay intact; benchmarks/fit_gf_adapt.py at >=40 trials). 10 mV under the measured stationary loom input (refit 2026-10-10, 40 trials; the strong-quartile constraint holds at 1.95, close to its limit of 2). Earlier 30 mV was fitted under the all-trials input; a 15 mV value came from an undersampled 20-trial fit. 0 mV gives up to 7 spikes per loom.
sustained MN rates < 100 Hz; Azevedo 2020; McKellar 2020
